---
title: Spr
description: High-performance spring physics library for smooth animations.
---

Spr is a spring-driven motion library that animates Instance properties using physics-based springs. Supports numbers, vectors, CFrames, colors, and more.

## Usage

```luau
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage')
local spr = require(ReplicatedStorage.Vendor.Spr)

-- Animate position with spring
spr.target(frame, 0.5, 5, {
    Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
})

-- Animate multiple properties
spr.target(button, 0.3, 8, {
    Size = UDim2.fromOffset(200, 50),
    Rotation = 15,
    BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100),
})

-- Stop animation
spr.stop(frame, 'Position')
spr.stop(frame)  -- Stop all properties

-- Callback when complete
spr.completed(frame, function()
    print('Animation finished!')
end)
```

## API Reference

### `spr.target(instance, dampingRatio, frequency, properties)`

Animates properties toward target values using spring physics.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `instance` | `Instance` | Target instance |
| `dampingRatio` | `number` | 0=undamped, 1=critically damped, >1=overdamped |
| `frequency` | `number` | Undamped natural frequency in Hz |
| `properties` | `{ [string]: any }` | Property names to target values |

### `spr.stop(instance, property?)`

Stops animation on specific property or all properties.

### `spr.completed(instance, callback)`

Registers callback when all springs complete for instance.

## Supported Types

| Type | Notes |
|------|-------|
| `number` | Any numeric property |
| `boolean` | Springs toward 0/1 threshold |
| `Vector2` | Position, scale |
| `Vector3` | 3D position, velocity |
| `UDim` | UI scale/offset |
| `UDim2` | UI position, size |
| `Color3` | Perceptually uniform color space |
| `ColorSequence` | Start/end keypoints only |
| `NumberRange` | Min/max values |
| `CFrame` | Position + rotation springs |

## Spring Parameters

### Damping Ratio
- `0.0` - Undamped (oscillates forever)
- `0.3` - Underdamped (some oscillation)
- `0.5` - Slight overshoot
- `1.0` - Critically damped (fastest, no overshoot)
- `2.0` - Heavily damped (slow, no overshoot)

### Frequency
Higher values = faster response. Typical range: `1-20` Hz.

## Examples

### Bouncy Button
```luau
spr.target(button, 0.4, 10, {
    Size = UDim2.fromOffset(150, 60),
})
```

### Smooth Color Transition
```luau
spr.target(frame, 0.5, 4, {
    BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 200, 255),
})
```

### 3D Spring
```luau
spr.target(part, 0.3, 6, {
    CFrame = targetCFrame,
})
```

## Performance

- Uses `PreSimulation`/`PostSimulation` for different instance types
- Automatic sleep when springs settle
- Zero allocations after setup
